name: Straitscreen
description: Sit the weight low behind the blade and let qi gather at the wrists while the point watches the foe.

name: Bold Hardtip
description: Lift the point from a low guard in a rising line that ends beneath the foe's chin.

name: Impaleswerve
description: Hop backward off both feet to reset the distance and land with the point already levelled.

name: Sure Squarepoint
description: Pull qi along the forearm to firm the wrist so a hard thrust does not bend the sword hand.

name: Stalwart Rigidtang
description: Beat the foe's strike upward off its line with the blade's lower edge and step in behind it.

name: Drillslap
description: Pack qi into the last hand's breadth of the blade so the tip bites through hardened leather.

name: Entangling Impale
description: Keep the blades together as the foe withdraws, sliding the bind along their steel to hold it.

name: Ducking Stiffspine
description: Step to the foe's outside as the blades touch, so the bind begins with the better angle already won.

name: Gagging Pierce
description: Cross the strong of the blade over the foe's weak and press down to take command of the line.

name: Keen Bracespine
description: Drop the point beneath the foe's guard and thrust upward into the unprotected underarm.

name: Longtang Barrier
description: Turn aside the foe's blade with a short sweep, qi stiffening the estoc against its weight.

name: Drillthwack
description: Swing the pommel up beneath the chin while the foe's blade is still held in the bind.

name: Straitlinen
description: Hold still in the bind and read the tremor of the foe's arm through the steel.

name: Brutal Bore
description: Release the bind sideways and thrust through the gap that the foe's own pressure opens at the throat.

name: Stalling Drill
description: Catch the foe's hilt on the crossguard and lever it outward until their weapon is wrenched off line.

name: Attentive Stiffblade
description: Run a slow stream of qi down the spine of the blade until the whole length hums.

name: Boreflog
description: Thrust with qi already flowing so the point leaves the guard warm and arrives without slowing.

name: Skewerzip
description: Cross the rear foot behind the lead and glide forward, keeping the point steady while the legs move.

name: Slenderprop
description: Hold the blade at hip level pointing forward so any approach runs onto the point.

name: Ruthless Squaretip
description: Slap the flat of the blade across the foe's forearm to numb the sword hand.

name: Gagging Gouge
description: Flick the tip in a small circle before the foe's eyes to draw their guard toward a false line.

name: Brisk Rigidtang
description: Pinch the qi to a single point at the tip so the thrust pierces a thick quilted coat.

name: Swift Hardtip
description: Draw the qi back as the point retreats and surge it forward again as the second thrust lands.

name: Gagging Skewer
description: Press qi through the crossed blades until the foe's wrist tires and the bind slides in your favour.

name: Genial Bracespine
description: Seize the blade at its middle with a gloved hand to shorten reach and add the off arm's push.

name: Brutal Trianglespine
description: Drive the shortened blade forward in a quick push that needs no wind-up.

name: Veering Thrustspine
description: Move in tight quarter steps inside the foe's reach while the shortened point stays pressed to them.

name: Squaretip Hasp
description: Knock aside a dagger or short cut with the half-held blade, both hands controlling the angle.

name: Binding Thrustspine
description: Press the point to the hollow of the throat and hold it there so the foe dares not move.

name: Fierce Impale
description: Lever the blade by its middle to steer the point precisely between two plate edges.

name: Brassslender
description: Hold the arm out with the point at the foe's face so they cannot step inside the blade's length.

name: Keen Stiffspine
description: Reach the lead foot out as the point travels so the thrust gains a full extra pace.

name: Rill Skewer
description: Edge the lead foot sideways in small steps to keep the foe at the tip as they circle.

name: Levering Pierce
description: Trace slow circles with the point so the foe's eyes follow it and their own blade drifts.

name: Straitcordial
description: Stand still at the tip's range and judge from the foe's weight shift when they will step in.

name: Rillstrait
description: Meet the foe's blade far from the body with the stiff forte and push it clear.

name: Gleam Trianglespine
description: Stab as the foe closes and withdraw in the same breath so the reach is never surrendered.

name: Brassgouge
description: Stretch qi a finger past the tip so the thrust lands a little farther than the foe judged.

name: Dusk Squarepoint
description: Hold the point at the foe's face and advance with it, driving them backward one step at a time.

name: Padded Longtang
description: Beat the foe's weapon down as they enter the reach and thrust at the line it leaves open.

name: Regimen Trianglespine
description: Keep the point at the height of the foe's eyes so every advance faces the narrow visor line.

name: Brass Drill
description: Thrust the tip through the eye-slit of a closed helm in one short, exact push.

name: Lunar Longtang
description: Watch the foe's elbow as it folds and note the instant its plates part.

name: Shard Gouge
description: Drop low and send the point into the soft hollow behind the foe's knee plate.

name: Gritslender
description: Weave left and right across the foe's line as you advance so no single thrust can meet you.

name: Hum Bracespine
description: Check the foe's descending blade on the crossguard and let it slide away from the wrist.

name: Static Thrustspine
description: Jam the point against the helm's brow and shove so the head snaps back and the stance breaks.

name: Honedimpale
description: Guide the qi-sharpened point to the hinge of an elbow or knee plate where the metal parts.

name: Straitscorer
description: Cast the body forward along one chalked line so the point lands exactly where it was aimed.

name: Slenderbandage
description: Learn the length of a lunge by stepping out a marked line and reading how far the point reaches.

name: Rill Bore
description: Push off the lunging foot in a spring that returns the body to guard before the foe responds.

name: Buttressed Stiffspine
description: Hold the stretched lunge with the blade and the free arm covering the exposed side.

name: Sprout Squaretip
description: Throw the free arm back as the sword arm extends so the body stays level in the lunge.

name: Slenderbarrier
description: Drop beneath the foe's cut and turn their blade aside with the forte as the point rises.

name: Cometpierce
description: Step the rear foot past the lead during the lunge to cover one more pace than the foe expects.

name: Dusk Pierce
description: Stop the lunge a finger short of the throat and hold it, so the foe dares not advance.

name: Comet Stiffblade
description: Lunge into the foe's own advance so their thrust falls short and yours lands first.

name: Stiffblade Cordial
description: Fix the eyes on the places where armor must bend and wait for the foe to move them.

name: Brass Rigidtang
description: Send the point through a gap no wider than two fingers with a quick, flat push.

name: Grit Bore
description: Rise onto the toes and creep inside the foe's guard with the point lightly resting on their chest plate.

name: Claytaut
description: Turn the body edge-on and tuck the arm so that no gap in your own armor faces the foe.

name: Haze Hardtip
description: Beat the foe's point barely off line with a tiny flick, enough to miss the gap and no more.

name: Static Gouge
description: Strike where the plate flexes as the foe raises an arm, entering before the gap closes.

name: Static Pierce
description: Lever the point inside a gap and twist to widen it, so the next thrust finds easy entry.

name: Clayslender
description: Lean the weight forward over a bent front knee with the point already pushing at the foe.

name: Keen Squaretip
description: Thrust and follow the point with the shoulder so the push does not stop at the first contact.

name: Grit Thrustspine
description: Lean into each step so the body's weight keeps flowing toward the point.

name: Poise Squarepoint
description: Set the off palm against the pommel and push with qi-stiffened arm to deepen a thrust.

name: Humstrait
description: Slide the blade down the foe's steel to the hilt and carry the point past their guard.

name: Honed Stiffblade
description: Press the point against a post and push until the whole blade bows, training the arm to hold the line.

name: Static Impale
description: Drive the crossguard and shoulder into the foe's chest to push them off balance before the thrust.

name: Skewerhasp
description: Walk the foe backward with the point at their chest, giving no breath to counter.

name: Gleam Bore
description: Drive the point forward with all the weight of the body and a full pulse of qi behind it.

name: Sleet Hardtip
description: Keep pushing the point along a crossed blade until the foe's guard collapses under the steady force.
